anachnid.bio: Montréal-based Oji-Cree and Mi'kmaq electronic artist Anachnid blends Indigenous perspective, experimental pop and electronic production in award-winning work rooted in identity and storytelling.

andreena mill.bio: Toronto-born R&B singer-songwriter Andreena Miller, formerly known as Andreena Mill, has been part of the city's contemporary soul and R&B scene since her teens.

bad child.bio: Kitchener-born Canadian singer-songwriter, producer and multi-instrumentalist BAD CHILD, born Isaiah Steinberg, makes genre-blurring alternative pop shaped by hip-hop, rock and electronic production.

cam kahin.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter and producer Cam Kahin makes raw, guitar-driven alternative rock that draws on pop-punk, grunge and emotionally direct songwriting.

chani nattan.bio: Surrey-born Canadian-Punjabi lyricist and songwriter Chani Nattan blends Punjabi musical tradition with contemporary hip-hop and has become a major voice in the global Punjabi music wave.

charlotte cornfield.bio: Toronto-born Canadian singer-songwriter Charlotte Cornfield makes intimate folk-rock and indie music built around observational lyrics, understated arrangements and multi-instrumental musicianship.

chastity.bio: Whitby, Ontario project Chastity, led by Brandon Williams, makes emotionally charged Canadian punk, hardcore and shoegaze rooted in suburban isolation and community-building.

dakota bear.bio: Treaty 6-born Plains Cree rapper and activist Dakota Bear uses hip-hop to connect Indigenous storytelling, community leadership and social-justice advocacy.

daniel son.bio: Toronto rapper Daniel Son is a Canadian underground hip-hop artist and Brown Bag Money founder known for rugged lyricism and collaborations with producers and MCs across North American independent rap.

danny fernandes.bio: Toronto-born Canadian singer, songwriter and dancer Danny Fernandes makes R&B and pop and first gained national attention as a performer before launching a solo recording career.

daphni.bio: Daphni is the dance-focused alias of Dundas, Ontario-born Canadian producer Dan Snaith, also known as Caribou, built around hypnotic house, techno and club-oriented electronic music.

david usher.bio: Canadian singer-songwriter David Usher is best known as the frontman of Moist and has also built a long solo career spanning alternative rock, pop and electronic music.

desiire.bio: Congo-born, Canadian-raised Toronto singer-songwriter Desiire blends R&B, Afrobeat, jazz and electronic influences in soulful, rhythm-driven music.

destroyer.bio: Vancouver indie-rock project Destroyer, led by Canadian singer-songwriter Dan Bejar, is known for literary lyrics and a shape-shifting catalogue spanning indie rock, chamber pop and art rock.

dirty radio.bio: Vancouver group DiRTY RADiO is a Canadian dance-R&B act that blends electronic production, pop songwriting and contemporary soul.

down ta erf.bio: Toronto trio Down Ta Erf brought together MC Mathematik and twin producers Wall and Steel, creating jazz- and soul-sampled Canadian hip-hop rooted in Scarborough's 1990s underground scene.
